title: Surreal Porch View
description: A circular porthole-like frame with peeling paint, keys, bolts, and feathers surrounds a surreal night scene. Inside, a cracked moon hangs over a dark sea where a green candle with a lit flame stands atop rows of purple theater seats, while illuminated boats and a haunted house float nearby.
prompt: Surreal circular porthole frame covered in peeling paint, old keys, bolts, and black feathers, looking into a dark seascape at dusk. A giant cracked moon floats in the orange sky. A tall melting green candle with a bright flame stands on a grid of purple theater seats arranged in rows on the water. Several ornate illuminated boats and a haunted house boat float nearby. Moody, atmospheric, detailed painting.
